Subject: Request: Migration PoC architecture review — timeline & slots

Hi Sofia / Marissa,

We're preparing an evaluation plan to move inference for our triage pipeline off our current provider and run a week-long PoC with Redwood. Before we commit an infra window, our infra lead (Daphne) and our platform engineer want a focused architecture review + migration checklist session to align on:
- current model sizes and KV cache expectations
- network egress / VPC peering options
- quantization/throughput tradeoffs for our LLM configs
- what instrumentation Redwood needs to validate latency / error budgets

Can we schedule a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive in the next two weeks? Daphne (cc'd) prefers mornings PT. I've attached a short CSV with our current token usage breakdown.

Attachments:
- current-usage-summary.csv (csv)

Thanks,
